title: Inhibition of STAT3 signaling contributes to the anti-melanoma effects of chrysoeriol.
authors: Liu, Yu-Xi; Chen, Ying-Jie; Xu, Bo-Wen; Fu, Xiu-Qiong; Ding, Wen-Jun; Li, Sze-Man Amy; Wang, Xiao-Qi; Wu, Jia-Ying; Wu, Ying; Dou, Xiaobing; Liu, Bin; Yu, Zhi-Ling
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮化合物chrysoeriol通过抑制STAT3信号通路发挥抗黑色素瘤作用，虽含MD模拟和SPR检测小分子与Src激酶结合，但核心是药物抗肿瘤效应，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Melanoma is an aggressive malignancy with a high mortality rate. Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), an oncoprotein, is considered as an effective target for treating melanoma. Chrysoeriol is a flavonoid compound, and possesses anti-tumor activity in lung cancer, breast cancer and multiple myeloma; while whether it has anti-melanoma effects is still not known. Chrysoeriol has been shown to restrain STAT3 signaling in an inflammation mouse model. PURPOSE: In this study, the anti-melanoma effects of chrysoeriol and the involvement of STAT3 signaling in these effects were investigated. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: CCK8 assays, 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine (EdU) staining, Annexin V-FITC/PI staining, Western blot analyses of cleaved caspase-9 and wound healing assays were used to study the anti-melanoma effects of chrysoeriol in cell models. A B16F10 melanoma bearing mouse model was used to evaluate the in vivo anti-melanoma effects of chrysoeriol. Indicators of cell proliferation, cell apoptosis and angiogeneis in melanoma tissues were detected by immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining and terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase-mediated dUTP nick end labeling (TUNEL) staining. Immune cells in melanoma tissues were analyzed by flow cytometry. STAT3-overactivated cell models were used to investigate the involvement of STAT3 signaling in the anti-melanoma effects of chrysoeriol. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays were conducted to determine whether chrysoeriol binds to Src, an upstream kinase of STAT3. RESULTS: The results of cell experiments showed that chrysoeriol dose-dependently inhibited viability, proliferation and migration of, and induced apoptosis in, A375 and B16F10 melanoma cells. Chrysoeriol inhibited the phosphorylation of STAT3, and downregulated the expression of STAT3-target genes involved in melanoma growth and metastasis. Mouse studies showed that chrysoeriol restrained melanoma growth and tumor-related angiogenesis, and altered compositions of immune cells in melanoma microenvironment. Chrysoeriol also inhibited STAT3 signaling in B16F10 allografts. Chrysoeriol's viability-inhibiting effects were attenuated by over-activating STAT3 in A375 cells. Furthermore, chrysoeriol bound to the protein kinase domain of Src, and suppressed Src phosphorylation in melanoma cells and tissues. CONCLUSION: This study, for the first time, demonstrates that chrysoeriol has anti-melanoma effects, and these effects are partially due to inhibiting STAT3 signaling. Our findings indicate that chrysoeriol has the potential to be developed into an anti-melanoma agent.
abstract_zh: 背景：黑色素瘤是一种侵袭性强、死亡率高的恶性肿瘤。信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）作为一种癌蛋白，被认为是治疗黑色素瘤的有效靶点。金圣草黄素（Chrysoeriol）是一种黄酮类化合物，在肺癌、乳腺癌和多发性骨髓瘤中具有抗肿瘤活性；但其是否具有抗黑色素瘤作用尚不清楚。已有研究表明，金圣草黄素在炎症小鼠模型中可抑制STAT3信号通路。目的：本研究探讨了金圣草黄素的抗黑色素瘤作用及其机制中STAT3信号通路的参与。研究设计与方法：采用CCK8实验、5-乙炔基-2'-脱氧尿苷（EdU）染色、Annexin V-FITC/PI染色、裂解型caspase-9的Western blot分析以及伤口愈合实验，研究金圣草黄素在细胞模型中的抗黑色素瘤作用。使用B16F10黑色素瘤荷瘤小鼠模型评估金圣草黄素的体内抗黑色素瘤效果。通过免疫组织化学（IHC）染色和末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶介导的dUTP缺口末端标记（TUNEL）染色检测黑色素瘤组织中的细胞增殖、细胞凋亡和血管生成指标。通过流式细胞术分析黑色素瘤组织中的免疫细胞。使用STAT3过度激活的细胞模型研究STAT3信号通路在金圣草黄素抗黑色素瘤作用中的参与。通过分子动力学（MD）模拟和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验确定金圣草黄素是否与STAT3的上游激酶Src结合。结果：细胞实验结果表明，金圣草黄素剂量依赖性地抑制A375和B16F10黑色素瘤细胞的活力、增殖和迁移，并诱导其凋亡。金圣草黄素抑制STAT3的磷酸化，并下调参与黑色素瘤生长和转移的STAT3靶基因表达。小鼠研究表明，金圣草黄素抑制黑色素瘤生长和肿瘤相关血管生成，并改变黑色素瘤微环境中免疫细胞的组成。金圣草黄素还抑制B16F10同种移植瘤中的STAT3信号通路。在A375细胞中过度激活STAT3可减弱金圣草黄素的活力抑制作用。此外，金圣草黄素与Src的蛋白激酶结构域结合，并抑制黑色素瘤细胞和组织中Src的磷酸化。结论：本研究首次证明金圣草黄素具有抗黑色素瘤作用，且这些作用部分归因于抑制STAT3信号通路。我们的发现表明，金圣草黄素具有开发为抗黑色素瘤药物的潜力。
